sections.heading: How much
sections.body: Aim for 3–6 months of essential expenses in a separate, accessible account. If you're a breadwinner or OFW with dependents, aim for 6–12 months because your family relies on your income. Use average monthly expenses (rent, utilities, food, minimum debt payments) as the basis.

sections.heading: Where to keep it
sections.body: High-yield savings or time deposits in PH banks. Avoid locking everything in long-term investments so you can access it quickly in a job loss or medical emergency.
